text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock D at losses, then buying Stock A back at a higher price, reminds me not to let fear alone drive exits; I should use a clear reason to sell.","A gain on an individual sale does not guarantee the account will rise, as my Stock B and E sales showed; I should judge decisions by the whole portfolio and longer-term results.","I should size new buys carefully and preserve diversification and cash, rather than letting several purchases in a short stretch concentrate my risk."]}
